_comment: Canonical research-question eval seed for the Cannavec Science v0.6 research-domain-breadth build. ≥ 187 prompts across ten category buckets (curated, rigor_positive, rigor_negative, refusal, live, cross_cutting, routing_surfacing, analytical_cultivation, clinical_pharmacology_depth, research_domain_breadth). The runner (evals/run_evals.py) drives the composer and asserts each prompt's declared expectations. Per-bucket minimums are enforced both at build time (this script's asserts) and at test time (tests/test_eval_coverage.py).
_gating_comment: MVP contract buckets gate the exit code (must be 100%): verification / rigor / refusal / routing / cross-cutting — the deterministic credibility promises. Coverage buckets (curated, analytical_cultivation, clinical_pharmacology_depth, research_domain_breadth) are tracked and printed but NON-gating: the MVP grounds via LIVE retrieval, not curated breadth recall, and forcing the static registry to memorize specific PMIDs is the M5 anti-pattern. Run with --strict-all to gate on every prompt.
